source: New. Faithful Latent ODE of Rubanova, Chen & Duvenaud (NeurIPS 2019): ODE-RNN encoder run backward in time -> q(z0 | observed prefix, d) -> latent ODE dz/dt = f(z, t, d) -> decoder to the absolute 128-D representation code. Trained with the extrapolation ELBO. The defaults below are the pre-search setting; the stage 2 search (validation only, ADNI PCA-128 seed 42) replaces them.
trainer_semantics: Each epoch draws samples_per_epoch training subjects with replacement. Each draw shows the encoder a uniformly sampled prefix of k in 1..n-1 visits, and the loss scores all n visits (reconstruct the prefix, extrapolate the rest). Codes are train-standardized; time is visit_age_norm_train, as for every other method. best.pt is the lowest validation first-to-last selection score, computed exactly as for the ODE methods, with the one-observation encoder. Training stops after early_stopping_patience epochs without validation improvement.
revision_history: attempt 1 (discarded, 2026-09-12): learned per-dimension observation sigma and one pass over the 475 subjects per epoch (8 steps). Every trial kept code MSE ~1 and validation score ~2 (worse than no-change), because the model widened sigma instead of reconstructing codes and saw too few updates. Fixed: sigma is a fixed searched value (as in Rubanova's released code) and samples_per_epoch = 4096 (matching the cocycle's draws per epoch).
early stopping (2026-09-12): stage 2 diagnostics peaked at epochs 3-13 and then overfit (train code MSE falling, validation worsening), so runs stop after 25 epochs without validation improvement.

selection.primary: macro CN/AD first-to-last decoded transport shape ratio

search.rule: Distinct configurations drawn without replacement from the grid; winner = lowest best_validation_selection_score; reused unchanged for every representation, view and seed.
